The lawsuit the Supreme Court agreed to hear isn't about fairness. It's not about so-called "election integrity," because millions of taxpayers' dollars have been wasted on state investigations looking for mail-in ballot fraud that simply does not exist.
This lawsuit is a political ploy to suppress legitimate mail-in ballots that are postmarked by Election Day and potentially delayed by the U.S. Postal Service. This lawsuit targets our fellow citizens who have done nothing wrong and might have their vote suppressed through delays out of their control. And it's all because the political party that brought the lawsuit knows that those delayed ballots are more likely to have been cast by voters for the other party and not themselves.
We cannot let anyone get away with such a cynical attempt at hidden voter suppression, no matter who controls the Supreme Court. RUSH $35 or more right now to help us spread the word about this lawsuit and defend the right to vote across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062226_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SCOTUS to Hear GOP Lawsuit That Could Radically Restrict Mail Voting [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062226_3&amount=25]
Team: Mail-in ballots are under attack again.
The Supreme Court agreed to hear arguments in RNC v. Wetzel, a lawsuit challenging Mississippi’s law allowing a five-day grace period for late-arriving ballots mailed by Election Day. In simpler terms, it's a case about whether your vote will count if you mail it on or before Election Day, but your ballot arrives after Election Day.
It's clear why a political party -- in this case, the Republican National Committee (RNC) -- is claiming that states must reject ballots that arrive after Election Day. Doing so would potentially disenfranchise a large number of voters, restricting the number of participants in an election. And the data is clear, over the last several election cycles, Republicans have been outnumbered in the use of mail-in ballots.
The RNC is making a blunt decision that their ability to win elections matters more than your vote. It's a cynical attempt to stay in power by suppressing ballots that are delivered late by the postal service. It's the kind of partisan work that shows they'd rather believe in their own power and control than the principles of democracy, of a country where all our votes should count, regardless of party.

Our position is clear: If your ballot was postmarked by Election Day, it should count.
This shouldn't be a partisan question. No political party -- Democrat, Republican, Green, Working Families, Libertarian, Reform, Conservative -- should be against voting. No party in our democracy should want to restrict the fundamental right of our fellow citizens to make their voice heard through voting.
But now we're facing a case where the Supreme Court’s decision could strike down or uphold laws in 16 states (and Washington D.C.) allowing late-arriving ballots postmarked on or before Election Day to be counted if they arrive within a set grace period.
How do we know what is at stake? Data from the 2024 Massachusetts elections shows that their three-day grace period for ballots to arrive after Election Day resulted in a 60% drop in rejected ballots as compared to no grace period. That means thousands of votes still counted, more than 1.5% of the total vote count. In a close election, that 1.5% could easily mean the difference between winning and losing.
Our fundamental right to vote should matter so much more than a partisan desperation to win. Chip in $35 or whatever you can to help us defend the use of mail-in ballots and make every vote count in elections nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062226_3&amount=35]

These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

## Local Win on Ethnic Studies
---
Peter Ohtaki — June 17, 2026
---
[Sequoia Union High School District’s May 26th settlement with six courageous families](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fpadailypost.com%2F2026%2F05%2F26%2Fdistrict-settles-antisemitism-lawsuit%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=p4liYpggJ-px-AUtv5UzbEaLJbY%3D) will require annual antisemitism training for all district employees who work with students, and teachers must clear any materials related to the conflict in Gaza with an Independent reviewer. In November 2023, we were appalled after downloading one-sided, pro-Palestinian Israel-Gaza war slides, which didn’t mention Hamas is a terrorist organization nor Iran’s role as the state sponsor of terrorism in the Middle East, both intent on the destruction of Israel. The slides went viral among Jewish families resulting in a lawsuit against the SUHSD over antisemitism.
#### What’s the Big Deal about Ethnic Studies? Oppressed versus Oppressor
We emailed the SUHSD Board on April 23, 2025 “As parents of 3 M-A teenagers, we’re very concerned about Ethnic Studies Curriculum teaching our kids U.S. history through the lens of [**oppressed versus oppressor**](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2019%2F4-27%2Fethnicstudiesgaza%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b%26ss_email_id%3D6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2%26ss_campaign_name%3DLocal%2BWin%2Bon%2BEthnic%2BStudies%2B%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-06-23T00%253A16%253A13Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=SxKZTr1afaNN5Xks_Rj13sycl_M%3D)**,** which divides our communities rather than celebrating the journeys of immigrants who have overcome discrimination. Last year, our youngest son as a Freshman was in the Israel-Gaza lesson, controversial among M-A families due to its one-sided presentation of the conflict to teach the “Counter-narrative” of the Palestinians, and **taught our son that Israel and the U.S. are oppressors**. District and State policy is for both sides to be taught on controversial issues. How will the Board and our Community be assured this policy is followed in this ethnic studies curriculum?”
---
| [](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2019%2F4-27%2Fethnicstudiesgaza%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b%26ss_email_id%3D6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2%26ss_campaign_name%3DLocal%2BWin%2Bon%2BEthnic%2BStudies%2B%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-06-23T00%253A16%253A13Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=SxKZTr1afaNN5Xks_Rj13sycl_M%3D)
---
| _We played a small role in discovering this biased lesson in my youngest son’s Ethnic Studies class._
---
#### Ethnic studies: Clarifying the debate
_June 26, 2025_ \- “The San Mateo Union High School District recently held a series of “study sessions” on ethnic studies. It was alarming that only one worksheet references the contributions and accomplishments of ethnic groups — the key stated intent of ethnic studies. However, in stark contrast, the **overwhelming majority of the content focuses on oppression, colonization, resistance and hegemony**. This reinforces the concerns of parents that there is a significant void between the stated intent (the what) of the curriculum and how it’s being implemented,” wrote Dan Torunian in a letter to the editor of the _San Mateo Daily Journal_ on April 19. Dan wrote, “As with every nation, our nation’s history is complex. The intention of high school ethnic studies would seem to support that premise as one cannot excuse history, but one cannot erase it either. What we can do, is learn from history and apply those learnings in our aspiration “**to create a more perfect union**. We wrote to the SUHSD about its proposed Ethnic Studies curriculum, “There’s no mention on this slide of the Civil War, Emancipation Proclamation and 14th Amendment, Brown vs BOE, Civil Rights Act, and efforts by this country to correct its slavery past. There’s no mention of the strategies utilized by other ethnic groups - Asians, Jews, Irish and Italians when first arriving in America to overcome discrimination. My father was forced into the Manzanar internment camp during WWII, and like other Japanese-Americans proved their loyalty by joining the U.S. Army Military Intelligence Service (MIS). We want our kids to be taught HOW to think, not WHAT to think.” **What’s the Consequences?** On January 23, 2025 Palo Alto Unified School District Board member Rowena Chiu was [attacked for her concern](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsfstandard.com%2F2025%2F02%2F11%2Fshe-survived-harvey-weinstein-can-she-survive-controversy-on-a-silicon-valley-school-board%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=XwN0erRobiYQ86gT8zdxt6uNurg%3D) Ethnic Studies will teach divisive controversial concepts. The teachers union asked the San Mateo Union High School District to censure Trustee Jennifer Jacobson for her [comments made at on Ethnic Studies forum](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.smdailyjournal.com%2Fnews%2Flocal%2Fteachers-union-seeks-censure-of-san-mateo-union-high-school-district-trustee%2Farticle_03da3bb4-fb09-11ef-9fce-2feb3a5a6f0a.html&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=0Ot-z9ydSmiKlRKxf0JUE8B3Rdc%3D) hosted by the Israeli-American Civic Action Network on February 26. Pro-Palestinian protests shut down major universities across the country in 2024, and protestors chanted “From the River to the Sea” or “Globalize the Intifada” not knowing those slogans call for the extermination of Israel.Protestors in Los Angeles in the summer of 2024 carried not only Mexican but also Palestinian flags, while throwing rocks and Molotov cocktails at ICE, Waymo cars, and burning the American flag. **Some who consider themselves Oppressed (called** _[**appropriated racial oppression**](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Frrapp.spia.princeton.edu%2Fshifting-focus-from-internalization-to-appropriation-of-racial-oppression%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=qQNRfb-ybKzFwNVC5L6SN-4Urdg%3D)_**) justify violence against those they perceive as Oppressors:**
* Luigi Mangione, a UPenn grad, murdered the United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson
* Elias Rodriguez from Chicago killed 2 Israeli embassy employees - a couple about to be engaged - shouting “I did it for Palestine, I did it for Gaza!”

**What can you do?**
1. Download your kids’ Ethnic Studies curriculum - Ethnic Studies is required for all California high school students starting 2026.
2. Join a non-PTA parents group, such as SUHSD Students First.
3. Lobby your state representatives to change the _[CA Model Curriculum for Ethnic Studies](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cde.ca.gov%2Fci%2Fcr%2Fcf%2Fesmc.asp&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=BlQXEnLLZa56Ph0vTJu9wdYXFCE%3D)_.
4. Run for school board.

This victory is part of a broader effort to restore meritocracy in our schools, as documented in _[Killing America](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a39d03d26faa3104bd89fa2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmanofsteele.substack.com%2Fp%2Fwatch-killing-america-full-movie&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a38be7b613bcb2b6e6fc81b&l=en-US&s=mX2ImlyxAL1e278Ii5OMo24JK-o%3D)_ by Eli Steele.

There are moments in life that change your path forever. | | | [](http://links.jessiedanielson.co/s/c/8nucY4jEZu_KG0A4zFhusPCA5p5mGMGD7xbYxyKpbqNrq39cFDvP80t3gMt5eYkakhBhkuQYtmT_Sdi5tF55SrkC_V96BrlRMyWwc6NnBHYpmm3EG1VekCE4DHbtD7-1Qxi55ft7BM6tZPb9XHaj6g_iHA40zyxZrhxatfan2FV6buwjGBr5y8sN8XM0jpz-IkSMRovu0oxyaIGbG3GP3MbSvR-VbyZL4B6l1kt8ZLEU0qJvcexHAEq-F2r2JioKS-23AuqFt6rNQzbqOjkOOdDgzyiTRnHZcIfaJGu33XyJ-AmTJbO3BBdtY523fV1kbBTrSdLHU7HXQLS_POAiDfu_4whHnNTd_rTgmdYsInlkp9xIvfpEsI9hZCxPrg6h5SUx4STSbyLZsCHW9CD8HK3xVboUz_liAJP4W1-SIL2tPCFfhU3L9NzWq511K0YWS0Jgr-QQxc_1QFOUfvWuZxOE2ATrqsBBhhjppuFuB1RINTaXlzDjuzRoFUcO_Q3wAyrIwvgpQyvdT7dJgm6mYhrBNvBaHhdUXbHuVepxK5v8DSJ1C2M7-UbuXGPikQsz7X6ORuAOfWQGALywVfmQYjxuYI8kltaA4aXBFKUr63HlthVZC4SfbN6xmCgU8CViiL7GuWFKFdwzdN6Q0IrKR-Ie6cw2QCYj0787pwbzEGt7AckCEndKCxLnqLC74BGsR6A5uFnGj3rSsldHKSQuCLcdA3yCgDDQfIwVDOhhy19nYCxzCL4I9fjrM9UfY0Tek2odfk4vvyeG_6nZe_baRECS-Gyeg4JwFGub7K9Xqbbl71px_92NB7i3aCHV5kz7DUfDdmjRWe0yUa45cYE_G-FJPDnDo2eCUfv2jqTOi5aothEQsuakaoHjEt5zuI_2nkCAkShYxpZ_hTJuhksGh8FvNlaBvEsqVFr7MQrzAg/ecw0cahscG2E-QGt-Knnvg-lnID0P0CE/22) Friend, There are moments in life that change your path forever. Nine years ago, as she prepared to run for the Colorado Senate, House Speaker Pro Tem Jessie Danielson sat down with me at a Starbucks inside a King Soopers and asked me to do something I never imagined I would do: She asked me to run for her state House seat. At the time, I was serving on Wheat Ridge City Council and had previously served on the local Fire Protection District Board. I was a survivor of domestic violence, a former homeless single mother, and someone who understood struggle far more than politics. Jessie saw something in me that I did not fully see in myself. She saw a leader. She believed that someone with my lived experiences, my commitment to community, and my servant’s heart could make a difference under the Gold Dome. Because she believed in me, I took that leap of faith. Looking back, that conversation at a King Soopers Starbucks changed the course of my life. It led me to eight years of service in the Colorado House, including four years as Majority Leader, and it reinforced something Jessie has always believed: when we open doors for others, we create opportunities that can change lives and strengthen our communities. **That is why I am proud and honored to endorse Jessie Danielson for Colorado Secretary of State.** As the first Latina to represent House District 23 and the highest-ranking Latina in Colorado legislative leadership, I know how important it is to have leaders who do more than talk about inclusion. We need leaders who show up, listen and fight for communities that have too often been overlooked. **For years, Jessie has been front and center on issues impacting Colorado’s Latino community.** She understands that when Latino families succeed, Colorado succeeds. She has consistently championed policies that create opportunity, protect workers, strengthen families and ensure every voice is heard. Jessie was a leader in passing the Farmworker Bill of Rights, extending long overdue workplace protections and dignity to the men and women who help feed our nation. She championed the Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, helping close wage gaps that disproportionately impact women and Latinas. She fought to protect workers from wage theft, expanded access to voting, supported paid family and medical leave, and has consistently stood with working families, immigrant communities and communities of color. She has never treated these issues as political talking points. She has treated them as matters of dignity, fairness, and opportunity. Time and again, Jessie has shown up for the people who need a champion. These accomplishments are not just policy victories. They reflect Jessie’s values. As the daughter of a first-generation Mexican American mother, the granddaughter of migrant farm workers, and someone who has spent my career working to open doors for others, these issues are deeply personal to me. I know what it means to come from a family that worked hard, sacrificed and believed in creating a better future for the next generation. Jessie has always understood those stories because she has spent her career fighting for those families. What I admire most about Jessie is that she leads with both strength and compassion. She listens first. She builds coalitions. She treats people with dignity and respect. And she never forgets who she is fighting for. Colorado’s Secretary of State plays a critical role in protecting our democracy and ensuring every eligible voter can participate in our elections. At a time when confidence in our institutions is being tested, we need a leader with integrity, experience, and an unwavering commitment to fairness. **Jessie Danielson is that leader.** She understands that democracy works best when everyone has a seat at the table and every voice has a chance to be heard. She has spent her career protecting those values, and I know she will bring that same commitment to the Secretary of State’s office. I know her character. I know her work ethic. I know her heart. Nine years ago, Jessie Danielson opened a door for me. She saw potential in a woman who had spent much of her life simply trying to survive. Because of her encouragement, I stepped into public service at the state level and have had the honor of serving the people of Colorado for nearly a decade. Today, I am proud to stand beside her and help open the next door in her journey of service to Colorado. Leadership is not about climbing ladders. It is about reaching back and helping others climb with you. Nine years ago, Jessie Danielson reached back and lifted me up. She believed in me before many others did, and because of that, I have had the privilege of serving the people of Colorado. That is who Jessie Danielson is. She opens doors. She creates opportunities. She lifts others up. [**And that is exactly the kind of leader Colorado needs as our next Secretary of State.**](http://links.jessiedanielson.co/s/c/_I0uJMEHy893uFisZgGKy-9UrMZ0f2lmHwQ54XVrFtXUraCHMtJaU0X5rvuRdlrfKr9kZ-_YjhB4AOSqkFRL__m4R3wLv19FKM-n5VKuPkZZzHDPvxlIYCjrFZBW7IrgXVLAR5wcz62nOU8FiZ8yFfReoKHCH1YlJzXGP4MKH0LtNznW0jKBjcx4I0LAju_QMqIr8QHZiqcZDzqrosqSzFhEhMsFDrMinL0RKMQAR_6M-0S-eKpTSGVJUOoJr5EPP4SxjOEbfH9qjnYGTisdt_va9-mKIGDGqzoW5rdqlENJ2qrhFEl0qowTCZHYykh0fITziaDT5Pk5uQzbfF0Cpya_k5zCx_Lq-sX-1EPnyxPkfJVSfi-lRtP5VVs47Bc_MyyPNZLaMPBUZGT-Sm2wZ86Wa7bzm5OaX57GSSi8dKnqvYO1CgCZXdDRvlR6QfEt_VQ2RUtRq2CQKeFd6zp4QHSGCGyqpgqwUleyAEMkCB8Sz7iiGNJYIfOZwIxmaNZsEPSsfP9l3JYbhrizP6NRu38CIhaFY1WZSzxg7jscJkhf1lH9HFlYqi-nkGGOp_GkvQvAdjQ20JeWwPIVPSJreLhL_BCienp4gbvWy4YTYRtaCkzXji04fmfFrbMgWJnoRNy8KJGLnLS8ELkQFMKAiJoa1nPEmORdkFVLSpuVoIazd4_nYIV0Lq3vPgGqXL1GSXq6IUnBWJA3jZ92rU3Ie7vbYWnUTZ1CjPDP9XU00sFHxywjiHbprwosRX_D9JIdgkEZnAGbLXUjKa6elC8V_AP_KlBuG2OQ-5INu-1MHsX3wP841bqm1zvaAmbVgktIXZqE0rv3m7D-vtpdVJcjCLQw0krpFEL7YfzuGlACZxLMSqgAniGVh4TnWPYsvVgD0A-jl8lOktNRullw-dMIrEPpOURR97a8TAe9Xd7M0Q/TmsQxGSQYrWr0ZCkr26VuubZAChsdJU9/22) Please join me in supporting Jessie Danielson for Secretary of State. body:
We have one of the strongest slates we’ve ever had, and our candidates have the potential to take back not just the House, but the Senate as well.
#
Peter — we’re approaching one of the last official quarterly FEC deadlines of this campaign.
With that important deadline coming up fast, we’ve had to make a difficult decision. And we felt we owed it to you to explain it.
Over the past 12 months we’ve spent upwards of $12 million backing candidates in races around the country. We have one of the strongest slates we’ve ever had, and our candidates have the potential to take back not just the House, but the Senate as well.
But winning those races is going to cost millions of dollars more, and believe us: it is critical that we win. Donald Trump isn’t just corrupt and unfit. He’s dangerous, and he’s going to destroy our democracy if we let him.
With MAGA Republicans lining up against our candidates and launching million dollar attacks of their own, we know we’ve got to step up to defend our team. The trouble is, our fundraising hasn’t been as strong as we anticipated this year. We just haven’t raised as much as we hoped.
We can’t spend money we don’t have, but if we don’t start making reservations now we could lose our edge. So, we made a difficult decision. We greenlit our budget for the rest of the year.
We’re not telling you this to brag, Peter. We’re telling you because we need your help. If you’re with us, and if you can afford it, can you chip in to help us raise everything we’re going to need for the home stretch?
[**Use this link to chip in $5, or anything you can. It would go a long way towards filling our budget gap after we started running those as. If we raise more, we can do more. Peter, I want to say a massive thank you to every single person who stepped up on a holiday weekend. Your grassroots support is the reason we are active and organizing in all 95 counties to break the Republican supermajority. But **we cannot let our foot off the gas for even a second.** This is the single most critical week of the entire fundraising quarter, which ends at _**midnight on June 30th.**_ This Wednesday marks a solemn and _infuriating_ milestone: **exactly four years since the conservative Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and stripped away our fundamental reproductive freedom.** In Tennessee, the consequences of that decision have been devastatingly real. **Tennessee’s Republican supermajority immediately enacted a near-total abortion trigger ban with no exceptions for rape or incest.** And during the 2026 legislative session, we watched a Republican state representative even propose making women who get abortions face execution. _**EXHIBIT 1 - JOINT FUNDRAISING NOTICE **_

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. The contributor's signature designates his or her contribution to the elections described above. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

**NEW VIDEO: PRESIDENT TRUMP ASKS LOUISIANA TO VOTE FOR JULIA LETLOW IN JUNE 27TH RUNOFF ELECTION** _Trump Says Letlow Is a "Strong America First Conservative" Who Will Fight for Louisiana_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — President Donald J. Trump is urging Louisiana voters to elect Congresswoman Julia Letlow to the U.S. Senate in Saturday's June 27 runoff election, releasing a new video message in which he calls Letlow a "strong America First conservative" and encourages Louisianans to "vote, vote, vote."
In the video, President Trump highlights Letlow's record of supporting his agenda in Congress and reiterates his complete and total endorsement of her campaign.
"Julia has my complete and total endorsement in the race," President Trump said. "She's a strong America First conservative who's stood with me from the very beginning, and she’s been tested at the highest level...”
_"Julia has my complete and total endorsement in the race,"_**President Trump said.** _"She's a strong America First conservative who's stood with me from the very beginning. She's been tested at the highest level, the most difficult level, and she's always performed."_
President Trump praised Letlow's work on border security, tax relief, energy production, and her support for Louisiana workers, farmers, and families.
_"Julia Letlow has been a true champion for you..."_**President Trump said.** _"She will help us deliver the largest tax cuts in American history again. She's been a loyal advocate for Louisiana's oil and gas workers, farmers, and fishermen."_
The President also emphasized the stakes of the election, telling voters that Letlow will help protect Louisiana's interests in the U.S. Senate.
_"With your vote, she will protect your borders, your paychecks, your jobs, and your Second Amendment,"_**President Trump said.**_"With Julia fighting for you in the Senate, Louisiana will be stronger and safer and more prosperous than ever before."_
Letlow said she is honored to have President Trump's support as the campaign enters its final days.
_"It is an honor to have President Trump’s complete and total endorsement, and I am so grateful for his trust and support,”_ **said Congresswoman Letlow.**_“President Trump needs reliable allies in the United States Senate who will help him finish the job, and when I am in the Senate, he will have one. I will work every day to secure our border, unleash American energy, cut taxes for working families, defend our constitutional freedoms, and fight for the people of Louisiana. Together, we will continue advancing the America First agenda and delivering results for our state."_
Louisiana's Senate runoff election will be held Saturday, June 27.

Trump is urging Louisiana voters to elect Congresswoman Julia Letlow to the U.S. Senate in Saturday's June 27 runoff election, releasing a new video message in which he calls Letlow a "strong America First conservative" and encourages Louisianans to "vote, vote, vote." In the video, President Trump highlights Letlow's record of supporting his agenda in Congress and reiterates his complete and total endorsement of her campaign. "Julia has my complete and total endorsement in the race," President Trump said. "She's a strong America First conservative who's stood with me from the very beginning, and she’s been tested at the highest level...” "Julia has my complete and total endorsement in the race,"President Trump said. "She's a strong America First conservative who's stood with me from the very beginning. She's been tested at the highest level, the most difficult level, and she's always performed." President Trump praised Letlow's work on border security, tax relief, energy production, and her support for Louisiana workers, farmers, and families. "Julia Letlow has been a true champion for you..."President Trump said. "She will help us deliver the largest tax cuts in American history again. She's been a loyal advocate for Louisiana's oil and gas workers, farmers, and fishermen." The President also emphasized the stakes of the election, telling voters that Letlow will help protect Louisiana's interests in the U.S. Senate. "With your vote, she will protect your borders, your paychecks, your jobs, and your Second Amendment,"President Trump said."With Julia fighting for you in the Senate, Louisiana will be stronger and safer and more prosperous than ever before." body:
| Peter,

I can’t believe tomorrow is Election Day. The day we’ve all been working so tirelessly toward for the past 18 months.

I know tomorrow will be a crazy whirlwind, so I wanted to be sure to take a moment now to say what’s in my heart: Thank you.

As you’ve probably heard me say 100 times, my parents taught me that 95% of life is showing up (my parents are here in my living room right now, by the way, making get out the vote calls!). And that advice has brought good things and good people into my life — many of whom have been with me on this journey since day one.

Peter, I can’t begin to express my gratitude for all the ways in which you’ve shown up for me and for this campaign. Whether you held one of those early meet and greets (when everyone you called replied, “Beth who?”), carried petitions in the freezing cold, knocked doors, made phone calls, marched in parades, or donated to keep our campaign running, you have brought us to where we are today. This weekend, thousands of Coloradans will gather in Castle Rock to celebrate America's 250th Birthday, Colorado's 150th Birthday, and the values that bring us together: faith, family, freedom, and community.
Whether you're coming for Greg Gutfeld, Lara Logan, Dog the Bounty Hunter, Larry Gatlin, Nick Shirley, the Back the Blue Bash, the Mountain Majesty Gala, or simply to spend time with fellow patriots, there's something for everyone at Freedom Fest.

Kshama is also the ONLY candidate in the race fighting to win **free healthcare for all funded by taxing the rich** , to **end all military aid to Israel** , to **stop the AI data centers and mass layoffs** , and for a **public-sector living-wage jobs guarantee**.

---
| | Dear Peter,
Kshama Sawant and supporters of her independent socialist campaign for the U.S. Congress will be having an exciting Pride Party at Squirrel Chops in Seattle’s Central District this upcoming Thursday, June 25th, from 7:00 pm to 9:00 pm!
---
| | **If you are in or near Seattle,****join Kshama at our Pride Party Fundraiser!**[**Thursday June 25th, 7:00 to 9:00 pm**](https://us.list-manage.com/9iDk54CriMO?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)[**Squirrel Chops in the Central District**](https://us.list-manage.com/19fgcu7aZfY?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
**Help us elect the socialist who beat the billionaires!**
**The primary election is on August 4th, just SIX WEEKS from now. **
**Help us fundraise so we can canvass throughout our district!**
---
| | Kshama is the only candidate in this race who has been a consistent and relentless fighter for trans and queer people. During her decade as the sole socialist on the Seattle City Council, Kshama helped build movements that won hundreds of thousands of dollars for an LGBTQ+ senior center in the heart of Capitol Hill and an LGBTQ+ wellness center at Seattle's NOVA High School. Alongside trans rights organizations, she also passed [proclamations](https://us.list-manage.com/42uLchnHPKy?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in consecutive years for Trans Pride Day. The victories Kshama won to advance the cause of queer and trans people were won by fighting against the opposition of the right wing and the Democratic and Republican parties.
Tens of thousands of working and young people across the country support Kshama’s revolutionary socialist campaign. **They want to fight the rich, not their wars.** They understand that the real enemy is the billionaire class, the same class Kshama has defeated time and again, not other working and oppressed people. They want free healthcare by taxing the rich, a massive expansion of social housing, and an end to the imperialist wars and the genocide in Gaza.
**They want to elect a FIGHTER to Congress, NOT another “team player”** for the Democratic or Republican parties.
Our campaign has been canvassing throughout Congressional District 9 in Washington state, including at many Pride events. We have spoken to tens of thousands of working people, including hundreds of queer and trans community members, in our district. Kshama’s campaign is demanding:
* An end to anti-trans attacks, and an end to all LGBTQ+ oppression
* Free healthcare for all by taxing the rich, including full gender-affirming and reproductive care
* The Equality Act
* A public-sector living-wage jobs guarantee, funded by taxing the rich
* The right to unionize for all workers
* National rent control and a massive expansion of publicly-owned affordable housing
* Free emergency housing for trans and queer people fleeing abuse
* Cut the war budget to fund housing, education, and social services

Kshama has strong, widespread support for these demands from working and oppressed people across all 50 states, DC, and Puerto Rico. That’s why Kshama’s campaign has had numerous supporters host fundraisers for us from Hawaii to Washington to Minnesota and even all the way to New York City. None of Kshama’s Democratic or Republican Party opponents has anywhere near comparable support among working people in the district or nationally. These include 29-year warmongering incumbent Democrat Adam Smith, another establishment-friendly Democrat named Melissa Chaudhry, and Republican Doug Basler.
**Kshama’s campaign has raised over $600,000 from 5,200 donors since we launched. Our campaign has 8.5 times as many District 9 donors as Adam Smith (Kshama’s main opponent), and seven times as many donors overall!** This is a massive accomplishment and shows the level of support Kshama’s demands and track record have in the district. However, Adam Smith has raised more money than we have so far from big pharma, the weapons industry, the Zionist lobby, and other nefarious corporate interests. They are funding Smith because they know Smith is a reliable fighter for the billionaire class, their wars, and their anti-worker, anti-LGBTQ agenda, and his track record over his almost three decades in office demonstrates that.
**Adam Smith’s track record:**
* Voted to send tens of billions of dollars for the Gaza genocide
* Funded endless bloody wars for nearly three decades, including the war on Iraq
* Championed a new trillion-dollar war budget this month on top of having cheerled $906 billion for war last December, money that Trump has used for the war on Iran
* Voted to create and fund ICE
* Slashed hundreds of billions of dollars from Medicare and Medicaid
* Condemned antiwar protesters as “left-wing fascists” and demanded they be arrested
* Voted to bail out Wall Street in the wake of the 2008 Great Recession
* Voted to break the railroad workers’ strike in 2022

The other Democrat running in this race, Melissa Chaudhry, recently and proudly declared, “I am a team player” to a roomful of Democrats. While she claims to be running a “progressive” campaign, Chaudhry is, in reality, running anything but that. She’s not campaigning for an end to military aid to Israel, for shutting down ICE, for universal public healthcare, or for LGBTQ or Black rights. She has NONE of this on her website. And there’s a reason — she wants the Democratic establishment to know she’s on their side.
Most shockingly of all, Chaudhry even [admitted](https://us.list-manage.com/JsY6GfMy84O?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) during a recent candidate interview that she does not even mention LGBTQ+ rights on her campaign website because she doesn’t want to offend a particular community. She is saying this in the context of scores of anti-trans ballot initiatives and bills being brought forward by the right wing across the country. **In stark contrast, Kshama has endorsed the**[**No Hate in Washington State campaign**](https://us.list-manage.com/18s1egnWO5Q?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**, which is calling for a NO vote on two proposed anti-trans ballot measures that threaten the rights of all children in WA state.**
Electing a revolutionary socialist like Kshama to Congress on the basis of solidarity with all working and oppressed people nationally and internationally would send a shockwave throughout the country.
So, if you’re in or near Seattle this Thursday, come out to Squirrel Chops in the Central District to get active, donate, and support this historic campaign to elect a proven fighter for queer and trans people and for all working people to Congress!

---

Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

This is the first post in what we hope becomes an ongoing series from The Angry Democrat writers and staff. **Angry Takes!**
[A recent Atlantic article has been making the rounds.](https://substack.com/redirect/c81f1706-ea26-4d1c-97c8-a0d7a85eaea3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) In it, Susan Crawford Shaw, founder of Grassroots Resistance, [GRR](https://substack.com/redirect/3d3657ce-51e4-4e83-8204-8ddf64c8868d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a Cleveland activist group, and its members said what a lot of Democratic voters already feel: they are sick of platitudes. They want more than slogans.
So do we.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/928eb20a-1ae1-4d7a-b92d-3d6c58338eee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Laura](https://substack.com/redirect/9bb7e7a0-5b11-479d-9692-6c37cc9d0cd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and I criticize the Democratic Party a lot. But if we are going to demand better, we should also be willing to say what better looks like.
So we both decided to take a swing at it.
These are the policies, priorities, and fights we think Democrats should be willing to run on right now. Some of our points overlap. Some go in different directions. But the point is the same: stop hiding behind vague language and start saying what you actually believe.
We are going back and forth here because this is not just one person's list. It is a conversation. It is Matt's take. It is Laura's take. And hopefully, it is the beginning of a much bigger conversation about what Democrats should actually stand for.
* * *
### Matt's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5da05b8-c30e-485d-bb54-9213290c83df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Healthcare for All**
I would not be surprised if Laura says the same thing. I have no clue what she is going to write, but for me, this is the starting point.
If you are not running on healthcare for all, I do not care about the excuses. I do not care about all the talking points about what it is going to cost.
Work out the numbers.
There are many countries that do it with better healthcare results and less money per capita. So stop the BS. Crunch the numbers and put it in your policy.
Talk about how much families will save. Talk about how much companies will save. Talk about how life expectancy and health outcomes will improve.
Then make a way to afford it.
Running on "lowering costs" or making it "more affordable" is weak tired and shows you have no balls.
* * *
### **Laura 's Take**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b30b95ad-3b2b-45f3-a71a-ccd54b337213?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
At this point, I am a yes for all of Matt's policies. But, I wouldn't be the policy wonk or outspoken Democrat I am if I didn't go a little deeper and maybe state the obvious in a few places. The bottom line is people right now want a fighter. These policy recommendations will make Democratic candidates seem more like one. They are also the right thing to do.
I spent 23 years inside the federal government across seven agencies. I know what government does when it works and is doing what has been mandated by Congress. I know what breaks when you gut it. So my list starts where Matt's transparency point leaves off. With accountability that has teeth.
**Impeach, Remove, Convict**
Democrats need to stop being afraid of these words.
When an official breaks the law, you hold a hearing. You build a record and collect evidence. You go to trial. Democrats keep treating accountability like a gift they hand out only when it polls well. It is not a gift. It's your job. Either we have a Constitution or we don't.
When a president defies a court order, or ignores the Constitution or the law, that is impeachable. When a cabinet secretary ignores a law Congress passed and a president signed, that is removable. The Constitution handed us the tool for exactly this. Use it. When the evidence supports a crime, prosecute it.
The daily corruption, graft, open-theft, abuses, state-sanctioned murders, and denial of basic human and Constitutional rights is wrong. We just went to an war in Iran Congress didn't ever approve - that is a power entirely reserved for them. As Democrats, how can we keep watching this and do nothing?
If you or I aren't above the law, then no President or politician is either. Say it like you mean it. Nothing else will be possible until Trump and his ilk are gone. Sorry, not sorry.
* * *
### Matt's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5da05b8-c30e-485d-bb54-9213290c83df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Reduce Deficit Spending and Balance the Budget**
We are nearly $40 trillion in debt, and about $1 trillion every year is going just to pay the interest on that debt.
That is insane.
Not only that, we spend close to $1 trillion on the military. Social Security is again under threat of becoming insolvent. We need to balance the budget, stop paying a trillion dollars in interest, and use that money to fund things people actually need, like healthcare.
But that does not mean the debt is fake.
Stop wasting the money. Balance the budget. Reduce the debt. Use the savings to help people.
* * *
### Laura's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b30b95ad-3b2b-45f3-a71a-ccd54b337213?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**It 's Time for a Living Wage. End Legalized Political Bribery**
Wages should be high enough to support a family.
Right now that lands around $30 to $35 an hour. [MIT's Living Wage Calculator ](https://substack.com/redirect/ebe4754e-8a8c-46dc-af21-b642c0f15837?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)shows a no-frills budget for a family of four runs $20 to $30 an hour per working parent, and well past $40 on a single income. The federal minimum has sat at $7.25 since 2009.
People know it is broken. [Polling by Data for Progress](https://substack.com/redirect/f9c0685c-a363-4a2f-a737-53b0544e9aab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found 74 percent of voters back a $20 federal minimum, 60 percent of Republicans included. Three quarters back $17. This is not a fringe position. It is a landslide Washington keeps ignoring. Unfortunately, you will never pry a living wage out of a Congress that answers to the donors fighting against one.
So, fix the machine. Pass a constitutional amendment (or similar legislation) to overturn Citizens United. Ban corporate money in campaigns. Ban the Super PACs. Publicly finance federal elections and run them to one national standard, so your ballot counts the same in Ohio as it does anywhere else.
Pay people enough to live. Then make sure the people they elect work for them, not the highest bidder.
* * *
### Matt's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5da05b8-c30e-485d-bb54-9213290c83df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Raise the Cap on Social Security**
It is absolutely ridiculous that there is a cap on Social Security. Once you make over a certain amount, you max out on what you pay into the system.
Social Security, like it or not, has become the default retirement plan for a lot of people. We are saving it away for them. So raise the cap, fund Social Security, and make sure everybody has a way to live in dignity.
With that said, the fact that we tax Social Security is absolutely absurd.
Do not tax Social Security.
At the same time, Social Security should not sit in a bank account losing money to depreciation and inflation. It should be in Treasuries or another safe structure that at least keeps up with inflation.
If we are not investing Social Security in a way that beats or at least keeps up with inflation, then we are failing.
The government is failing.
Just admit it and do better.
* * *
### Laura's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b30b95ad-3b2b-45f3-a71a-ccd54b337213?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Rebuild the Civil Service. It Keeps You Alive**
They answer the phone at Social Security. They Inspect your food. They show up after it floods. I got dialysis patients to their appointments across 19 states during the pandemic. Government keeps people alive in ways you never see until it stops. It is also what you pay for.
About 317,000 federal workers were purged in 2025, [reported by Bloomberg](https://substack.com/redirect/a030bedc-22e9-4548-be6d-c13627ff83dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Office of Personnel Management data. On June 3 an executive [order](https://substack.com/redirect/46301969-8496-4026-ba25-a4f2f2e9793f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) made about 8,000 career experts "at-will," with an accompanying agency rule that will likely lead to an additionally 50,000 more civil servants being purged. Every single firing is illegal.
HHS announced cuts of 20,000, a quarter of the agency, [per Government Executive.](https://substack.com/redirect/3110d549-66f9-478b-b8e7-e214e86f1b27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) This is not waste, fraud, or abuse. Federally funded research is behind every new drug the FDA approved from 2010 to 2016, [STAT](https://substack.com/redirect/682dcd2f-d98e-4498-aa86-02f5d9f685d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reported (FDA, NIH, HHS, and even DoD supplements budgets for drug research and trials). Anyone who thinks we built American science without the civil service is delusional.
The goal of this administration is to get rid of every civil servant, privitize every public service, help themselves to your tax money, and govern on high from a board room. Don't let it happen. Reinstate every program, rehire every worker, honor every contract, and expand the civil service.
* * *
### Matt's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5da05b8-c30e-485d-bb54-9213290c83df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Universal Basic Income**
I was part of the Yang Gang.
Andrew Yang was the only person talking about the future and trying to future-proof America. Everybody else was focused on the now or looking backwards, trying to fix problems that had already gotten out of control.
Yang was the one saying, hey, there is this thing called AI and robotics, and it is going to take a lot of jobs. It is coming. Can we please start talking about it?
Everybody laughed at him.
But somehow, as an unknown candidate, he made it through to become one of the last people standing in the Democratic primary.
Why?
Because he had an actual fucking policy.
With the rise of AI, automation, robotics, Tesla's Optimus, Waymo, self-driving cars, Tesla's self-driving fleet, and AI replacing real work, now is the time to start introducing universal basic income.
No, that does not mean everyone is to be on the government dole.
It means we need policies in place so companies are not just lowering their costs, replacing workers, and eating all the profits for shareholders while workers get displaced.
There has to be a policy where some of those profits are shared or dividends payed with the country they are doing business in, the workers who are displaced, and the communities where jobs are lost.
* * *
### Laura's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b30b95ad-3b2b-45f3-a71a-ccd54b337213?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**End Our Current Immigration System; Hold Officials Accountable for Deaths and Abuse**
Renee Nicole Good, a mother of three and a [legal observer watching out for her ](https://substack.com/redirect/50c177a6-fba9-4e05-9b8a-b341226c5bd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)neighbors, was shot through her windshield by an ICE officer in Minneapolis this January. Two weeks later and less than two miles away, Alex Pretti, an intensive care nurse at the Minneapolis VA, was shot by Border Patrol agents while trying to help a woman they were accosting. Months later, [the federal investigations into both deaths ](https://substack.com/redirect/7a52e6e7-a982-49da-9acd-c8eccb4a0e6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)remain stalled, with the administration fighting to withhold the evidence.
That sits on top of [31 people](https://substack.com/redirect/fea6a8c4-019d-47de-931a-bc68b72d7b11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who died in ICE detention in 2025, the deadliest year in two decades, while the office meant to investigate those deaths [lost hundreds of staff ](https://substack.com/redirect/6670e0eb-6298-4bc9-8c10-e8749fd2ded7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and went dark during the shutdown. I shouldn't have to even mention that we are also imprisoning young children and infants, allowing sexual abuse of young girls at detention centers, engaging in starvation, beatings, and murders of those detained.
These victims aren't fodder. They are why this has to end.
We need to end ICE as we know it and rebuild immigration enforcement from the ground up. One that solves the backlog instead of terrorizing human beings. We need to fund real processing capacity, real asylum courts, and iron clad oversight. Then we need to seek justice, and prosecute the officials who gave orders for, or let people die in the street and in custody. Not reassign them. Not let them retire. Prosecute them.
* * *
### Matt's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5da05b8-c30e-485d-bb54-9213290c83df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Transparency**
Everything in government is so obscure.
Yes, there are records requests, but they get delayed. Police departments drag their feet. Governors drag their feet. Departments drag their feet. Everyone has an excuse.
You are not allowed to do this. You need to file that. You need to wait. You need to appeal.
No.
This is a government of the people.
Unless something is classified, top secret, related to clandestine operations, protecting assets, or some real national security concern, everything should be auditable and transparent to the American people.
Build trust in government.
Let us audit how much the pencil costs.
Is this like Independence Day, where a toilet seat costs $35,000 and a hammer costs $2,500?
The people should know.
They should be able to go to a website, type into a search bar, and get the receipts for what we are paying for.
And PS: if the Pentagon fails another audit, people should get fired. If there is fraud or misconduct, there should be prosecution.
* * *
### Laura's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b30b95ad-3b2b-45f3-a71a-ccd54b337213?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Democrats Need to Clean Their Own House**
Voters do not separate the parties on corruption anymore. [Ninety-two percent of ](https://substack.com/redirect/78aed485-fbe9-4de2-9249-6f91aad9dfd6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)them call corruption a big problem in politics, rating Congress corruption at 85 percent, and not just the president. Democrats should know a battleground poll found voters in frontline districts see Democrats as more corrupt than Republicans, even while Trump's own scandals dominate the headlines.
After this presidency, voters will be starving for a real anti-corruption party, not just one that points at Trump's. There is movement already. [AOC, Jason Crow, and Mike Levin just launched an End Corruption Caucus](https://substack.com/redirect/8a7223a7-1fff-4a63-b650-791419267c58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) inside the House Democratic caucus. Good. Now point it inward too.
Democrats have to turn informer on their own party. Investigate our own dark money. Audit our own endorsement deals. Name our own insiders trading access for loyalty. The party willing to police itself first is the only one voters will ever trust to police Washington after this.
* * *
### Matt's Take
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5da05b8-c30e-485d-bb54-9213290c83df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Campaign Finance Reform and Ending Stock Trading in Congress**
This is simple.
You cannot have trust in government if government officials are front-running the books.
You cannot have trust in government if they are in bed with big business.
You cannot have trust in government if members of Congress are trading stocks while writing laws that affect those companies.
And you cannot have trust in democracy if, at any minute, Elon or any other billionaire can put a tiny fraction of their net worth into elections and change the whole field.
## [Elon Musk Could Fund a Political Machine Forever](https://substack.com/redirect/f3baaa83-11df-463e-ad94-8741cef6ccb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [The Angry Democrat](https://substack.com/profile/102996536-the-angry-democrat)| | *
---|---|---
| Jun 22
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f3baaa83-11df-463e-ad94-8741cef6ccb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[This is a thought experiment about political power.](https://substack.com/redirect/f3baaa83-11df-463e-ad94-8741cef6ccb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/f3baaa83-11df-463e-ad94-8741cef6ccb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Campaign finance reform must happen.
End congressional stock trading.
Limit the power of billionaires and corporations to buy influence.
Make elected officials work for the people again.

## US and Iran Make Progress in Switzerland Talks
U.S. and Iranian negotiators wrapped a second day of talks in Switzerland on Monday, with Vice President JD Vance touting [major progress](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb8GOx18KGpBkcZu06Z0nvBQsggOkHX27zPmF9Lc5s6cO_d8PZYHOu_C9okHqWLjEujKnkqhtPxkDMYlDAc-6UxxS5Tzhh4X4CBrLmsQi0Hn30tXGWWJgERFqh1GAD51IKpdTZMYzTiIqRdt21stV2GHlThpMquVpnLqpnEJouUtB2gErHIEyXs79EKjYB0n40pMzXd0oexk_Tu-KDU6HpVXeylnZuKDwcxgvq6r0WHVd8lgvtEMZn4HAIP5hUFTfZ-qNWEm6xLVBf0z1w4JaxfySbrElJu9HL5KypyX895lObCObwc6_zdc_mXrpeA3AAD__yXEfas) toward ending the war. Vance said Iran agreed [to let nuclear inspectors back](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQBuCngc3InI0hg4cubOnaER1wJm4OjGwnNH36irxCx9NJ_6_v_7oOV_Tst-UTV7LZhWGjIzHlTHF4JNxmH3Fb8U57DEuklBZkHECCEdIIUMOMnl-DLmfriIBUSbZuOwB50aDKm61Bt6PCWusLmg7RuVFDJ2sycmxc3ZTenmnSgKplLQEqBaPpwMjGtY2aUBVa0uxziNV38Fu-keNXeFKsprCWbG8576lQHwX0BfTHcVQu_JyK819Az_5J4rwL6B9JnB6xE04kZkIW22Niwigy8j2JdPj8S5Fxm98-EGDKaOf98Mw-mbbQclnR87s8_2uxp4W_AAAA__-fjn_J) in, a U.S. demand Tehran later disputed. Negotiators also set up a channel to keep the Strait of Hormuz open and hold a regional ceasefire. In return, the Treasury [eased sanctions](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnDAURb_GdB6ZZ8aQwsWsIrpNE0Up0Rv8DC9rbGSbQZuvj8gvbH2kq3vO7_fpHTlwXH7gRrb6NEU6S6BaKU9Hweg4Y9zwg_aclkylLBhwAgVGKiNBTw45fE5d46wnAtIN2bYfANS3DnSz2rkb3OB122I_o_Oe7tB3nlrTmeez7fuG7bWmDOhWtQrgpuFpBjDq7vu7nlGLTpHjmvLtT-JYV_LhM70o3-a0NcGute5F6IeAUcB4nudtK_FiAkaK8igCxkvqgikHJ2A8isSjrinzXyryMmSMMnGQBQMViRs7WTF8FJmi9BwxyJ1wJukIg4ARs3w8wCy_Xm9Cj2lmJ_T3tysjneUn5b3J1u0nh8DF9KJTy4Yc_h-uX6r8svAvAAD__-v9kmk), issuing a 60-day license that lets Iran sell oil through Aug. 21. Vance said any unfrozen Iranian funds would be [steered into American crops](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFywyAQRU-DOjxowUguKNKoc9qUmjWsJBIEGsDW-PYZcoU02-yfN__9r_t8Rx98XD9xJ1OXNEc6S6BaKc_PgtH5jHHHHzpyWjOVsmLAGQRoLjQHOTv04T2rzpmFCEh2ZPphBBA3BbLbjALrlod1cpBKa_WwhCOObgRJt97aW-dNowkNshe9ALhIeOgRtLguw1ValEwJcr6mfPlOPtaNlvBOL8oXm_YumK3WozD5wWBiMMX3kUptLwZTAzOYRDsADKYz5eB4U2QwPQs_0b-o8ObIkw-8YLTVp1j4kjKvZ-J7inVr6S4bd5w-BF_0wJRYd_Thr0L9124vA78BAAD__0xHgS4), buying corn, soybeans, and wheat from U.S. farmers to feed the Iranian people. More talks are expected this week.
## World Cup's Highest-Paid Players
The 2026 World Cup may be the [richest field](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAQAL8Gd1jL4hCnoHiNu7z2SmsDa8MdNhZwifz3p9wvXD-akebjPt8ppriv_2lj25Y87_yqiVvjMn9X2n0stG_0xUfJa-FaV0o0I6CRYCTq2VNM5zx03i7MyLpjq64jItwG1F2wGm5IzmsatXq4h_KGwPlFgSd3UW7oon3bwKBWoACx1_gwIxq4LNeLdqTFAOxjy6X_zHFvgZd05ieX3uWtSza0dlSh_wmcBE71yKXV_qSQ8xsQOFFp0SWuAqeSd0o-y5aPKkNcA9cmD4pevnJJXqobgkZQYx_alrpi_fGKKcVqrmKAdaOYfqvtT6ueFn8CAAD___q0fgQ) the sport has ever assembled, and one name towers over the money list: Cristiano Ronaldo. The 41-year-old pulled in close to $300 million over the past year, most of it from his Saudi club, finishing well ahead of second-place Lionel Messi, who recently joined the billionaire club. Both stars are playing a [record sixth World Cup](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdI7MGgwpKK6h-6-9Em3shezFeJHt_Chvf-J_hetGGs1o5vvztXwhR07bb9xpqqssic4SqVbKy7tgCpwx7fiiI8uWqZQNIy5gwGnjNNglIMfP0jVhWomAbENTO4wA5t6BbZ7TaJ3vx7a9j_0w2v4B1Id7a6gNZh0GfDQ8XW3GgW1NawBuFh5uBGf6deitR6s6Q4Gr5Ntf4VSftMaPfFO-edmbOD1rPYqyvxTMCubzPG9UjnSZCuYi3lO-RJX8UTAvCmYOCuZuvA_QOXdlJMeg_fvQP78iS6KodyqFtc9cKmMSnSVhDKLLU84gZ9KvJP4l71o05o1S5YT6kFzfG8YmT-E4OUYublCd2Xbk-DO4_hfl7wn-BQAA__8rX5HT) this summer, almost certainly the last for two players who have defined the game for nearly two decades. The money is not all going to veterans. Spain's Lamine Yamal cracked the top 10 at just 18, a teenager already out-earning nearly every pro on the planet.
## Former Fed Chair Alan Greenspan Dies at 100
Alan Greenspan, the longtime [Federal Reserve chairman](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAYhJ9GOwz-KLoFxW3s9ra3ND_wo9yDYIBds29_4nmF081kksnM9--5PtEHH7e_eJCqLq2RrhKoVsrrq2C0PmM88IvOnLZMpWwYcAUOknHJQKwWffisQ2uVIwISLal-mgH4YwDR7sqBMCiNtpKPcjQP10_zrK2eZsGdFrr16m7jEkTPew7QCdByBslHN43CoGgGTtbXlLv_yce6kwuf9KbcmXS0Qe21nqURfxpYGliu6-qiNveLO29guWUDS9K-vjB7ug0GjGzLRLGcGBmZFNPhS2Uhxa36g9hOaJkjSxkDy1Qov4lZT4X1nLNsIg4As2yzsuflQ_BFTs3AtwN9-BlWf0XzreA7AAD__1DoiwE) once called "the Maestro," died Monday at his Washington home from complications of Parkinson's disease. He was 100. First appointed by President Ronald Reagan in 1987, he led the central bank through four presidencies until retiring in 2006, the [second-longest tenure](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9utDAQBPCnMZ3RsubfFS6-hu6-NiVa8BqcGBvZzqF7-4i8QpppRvppNB_P-UnOu7D9p4N1sXEOfGXPpXCavzMF4xKFg774THFLnPNGnmYE7CX0EtVsyPn33FZGW2ZkVbFuhhERHi2qatePrgFmWtt16ZsBaLBjMygcF-zaBc2jcvrWoEfVQAOItcKlH7GHzg6dWkmJFti4ElP9GV0oO1v_ji9O9RqPyuu9lDML9U_gJHC6rqtew7LepcDppgVOcAeiwIk8Bbkl5pBPCtLGdHCS604uHRRktLLsLC0baRxnSUXSxrIBqPdy-Cppc17Oe5f7QbSwHeT8747yp_NeGn8CAAD__45IgTY) in Fed history. He won praise for steering a record-long economic expansion, then faced blame for the low rates and deregulation that critics say helped fuel the [2008 financial crisis](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuwyAUgOHTwOYIHgTsgaGLt3TtaL2Yh02LsQXEUW5fpVfo_Evf8H_dphvGFPPyiRu5FvYp07Mmao3K9KiYfSyYN_yho-xLoVoXTDiBANMJ04GaPMb0mjT3LhABKU5O2h5ADBoUX10QMFs0spdBD8ZKo0H2IFS4D37WJHh0b00YUFJIAXBRcDc9GHEN9qpmVEwL8rHt5fK9x9xWCum1n1Qu877x5NbWjsrUB4ORwdhWWmNK78ZgvD9qzFQrg_E6KGUH22HC3C2FKNcDcxfIU8HUFapUTmIw8uL88YwpxWos02LZMP55vP1r0OngNwAA__-T3Hji), a view he later acknowledged. The jazz-playing economist briefly attended Juilliard and was part of the [inner circle of free-market author Ayn Rand](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSnSAQRp9GO5x1QdTCIo3dnzals8iiJAgOkGvu22duXiH1N_PNOefH1_ZFPvh4fKeLl-rSFvkpgWvlvP0uFK3PFC_6xXdOR-ZSDgq0IaAWoAXKzZIP7021dnHMyLLlpR8nRJgVyvZcegPKDMw9q32cjUNt2TgDxvHg3MitXz5voFH20ANiJ9HoCTUMbhzkTrJRwNbXlLufycd6sgvv9OLc7elqw3LWepdGfmtwbXB9nqdz6Q_Kz9rg-tFpcHUpX5yFY8uZgshcOL9Y7Cf5fFEUFCiKIzPHclMU1nMRVEUP0OBKufo98KYmM82DJoEISgwTsJhhsgJ5VNM-z8qMujvrFdq82PvxIfiix0bBcZEP_3DrfzV-Lfg3AAD__2bFj0k). He warned of "irrational exuberance" and was married to NBC News correspondent Andrea Mitchell, who announced his death.

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Friend, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

clean_body: This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously | | | | FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH Friend, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation. Let me give you the facts. A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history. Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming. The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections. It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you. The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct. Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage. I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back. In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won. Ken Paxton can win this race. President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that. Texas is not going to flip because the Democrats got lucky. It will only flip if we let them. Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House P.S. | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | | Pop Acta Media | Republican Task Force PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _
